topic: Reviewing mall analytics and visit frequency calculation
summary_markdown:
The session began with troubleshooting data discrepancies, specifically regarding 'Visit Frequency' in the Mall Analytics dashboard. Initial issues involved outdated frequency data on staging and production environments, which were subsequently deployed/fixed.

Later, a detailed review of the Visit Frequency formula was conducted. The participant noted that the expected Cluster Frequency calculation (Sessions Frequency / Average Screen Seen) did not match the observed value when calculating for multiple days. It was discussed whether 'Average Screen Seen' is calculated daily or if the formula needs adjustment based on time range.

The participants agreed to postpone a deeper dive into this specific analytical discrepancy until the following day.
decisions: The Visit Frequency calculation methodology requires further review due to discrepancies when analyzing multi-day data.
action_items: Follow up on the visit frequency calculation and formula validation tomorrow.
